title: Aplicaciones
description: Consumo de RAM y CPU por aplicación

panels.title: CPU de los pods
panels.description: Milicores: 1000m = 1 núcleo. El clúster tiene 16 núcleos.

panels.title: RAM del clúster
panels.description: Working set de los pods sobre la RAM total de los 4 nodos (32 GB).

panels.title: CPU por namespace
panels.description: Media de los últimos 5 minutos, en milicores.

panels.title: RAM
panels.description: Más claro = más RAM. Escala: 32, 64, 128, 256, 512 MiB, 1 GiB.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Más claro = más CPU. Escala: 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200 milicores.

panels.title: RAM
panels.description: Apps: el resto. Plataforma: argocd, authentik, cert-manager, grafana, prometheus, cnpg-system, postgres. Infraestructura: longhorn-system, metallb-system, ingress-nginx, kube-system, pihole-system.

panels.title: Consumo por namespace
panels.description: Pedida = requests (lo que el scheduler reserva). Barras: RAM hasta 1 GB, CPU hasta 250m.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (namespace, workload) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))), "workload", "instance-manager", "workload", "instance-manager-.+"))))

sort_desc(sum by (namespace, workload) ((1000 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))), "workload", "instance-manager", "workload", "instance-manager-.+"))))

panels.title: Uso frente a requests
panels.description: Pico = máximo en el rango de tiempo elegido. Referencia para fijar requests (≈ uso normal) y límites (> pico).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) ((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")) or max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))), "workload", "instance-manager", "workload", "instance-manager-.+")))

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: Reinicios totales desde que se creó el pod.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info)

sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1))
